intro.text: A young count of the Teo court, once engaged to Sarene.

items.text: For a time Sarene tried to hold her personality in check and live down her name as an abrasive troublemaker. Few at court believed she had really changed, and she had often embarrassed its men, but Graeo was bold enough to court her. She was fond of him in spite of his slowness, and the two became engaged.

Sarene did not love him, though, and decided it would be wrong to marry on a false footing, especially as her true nature would overwhelm him. She ended the engagement. Ashamed, Graeo withdrew from court to his estate and lived as a recluse for three years, while rumours that Sarene had humiliated him on purpose hurt her name further and drove her into diplomatic service.

personality.text: Not quick-witted, but brave enough to court Sarene despite her habit of embarrassing the men at court.
Earnest and well-meaning, in many ways more like a child than a grown man. He meant well in everything he did, hoping to get ahead in life though the people around him were sharper.
